blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Wednesday issued a show cause order against motorcycle taxi platform provider JoyRide PH over a viral video showing one of its riders allegedly sexually harassing a young female passenger. In a statement, acting LTFRB Chairman Greg Pua Jr. said the order demands an explanation on why the platform’s authority to operate as a Motorcycle Taxi Platform Provider (MTPP) should not be suspended or cancelled.
